company.shortDescription: RetainIQ is an e-commerce marketing company that works with global brands and helps to grow online sales.
company.description:
RetainIQ is an e-commerce marketing company that works with global brands and helps to grow online sales. It enables brands to segment and send personalized messages powered by AI to the customers at scale.

The company was founded by Arpit Gupta, Sulakshan Kumar, and Sitakanta Ray in 2021 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE, US.

productsAndServices.description: A tool for creating and managing e-commerce catalog ads with dynamic designs and multiple product images to improve ad performance and return on ad spend.
productsAndServices.name: Enhanced Catalog Ads

productsAndServices.description: Plug-and-play dynamic email widgets that personalize email content based on user data to increase engagement and revenue from email marketing campaigns.
productsAndServices.name: Personalized Email Widgets

productsAndServices.description: Pre-built and customizable email automation workflows designed to engage customers at various stages of the sales cycle, from pre-purchase to post-purchase retention.
productsAndServices.name: Email Marketing Automation Workflows

productsAndServices.description: A service to create personalized SMS marketing campaigns using customer data to improve engagement, loyalty, and sales, especially during seasonal promotions.
productsAndServices.name: SMS Personalization and Campaigns
